about: Data sources and abilities the hub offers every agent. Each has an auth method, the .env variables it needs, and the tools it exposes (defined in src/sources/<module>.js). Agents that support tool calling (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok) call these tools themselves; for the others the hub fetches a summary first when the request mentions the source. auth "local" sources need no key.

sources.name: Macs (workers)
sources.notes: Always available on the hub Mac. Connected once at least one Mac is registered in the Machines tab.

envs.label: Admin API token
envs.hint: Shopify admin → Settings → Apps → Develop apps → create a custom app with read_products, read_orders, read_all_orders, read_inventory, read_customers, read_reports → install → reveal token (shpat_…)

envs.label: Private API key
envs.hint: Klaviyo → Settings → API keys → Create private key with read access (pk_…)

envs.label: System user token
envs.hint: Meta Business Suite → Business settings → Users → System users → Generate token with ads_read (long-lived)

envs.label: Ad account ID
envs.hint: Numbers only, from Ads Manager (act_ prefix added automatically)

sources.name: Google (Analytics, Ads, Merchant Center, Business Profile)

envs.label: OAuth client ID
envs.hint: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client (Desktop or Web, redirect http://localhost:4747/api/oauth/google/callback)

sources.mentions: \b(google|analytics|ga4|sessions|traffic|conversion rate|google ads|search ads|pmax|shopping ads|merchant center|business profile|gbp|google reviews|maps)\b

envs.label: API key
envs.hint: Vista Social → Settings → API (needs a plan with API access)

envs.label: Token
envs.hint: Bearer token or API key for that endpoint

envs.label: MCP server URL
envs.hint: Vibe's MCP server URL, if Vibe publishes one

sources.name: Memory
sources.notes: Facts, preferences and daily notes in agent-hub/memory/. Every agent reads them; any tool-calling agent can add to them.

sources.name: Skills
sources.notes: Playbooks in agent-hub/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Type /name at the start of a request to run one.

sources.name: Schedules
sources.notes: Reminders and recurring prompts. Results land in the Scheduled chat and on Telegram.

sources.name: Browser
sources.mentions: \b(browse|open (the )?(page|site|website|url)|go to (https?:|www\.)|screenshot|fill (in|out) the form|click (on|the)|log ?in to the site|website says)\b
sources.notes: A Chromium browser on the hub Mac that agents can drive: open, read, click, fill, screenshot. Installed on demand (Playwright).

sources.name: Composio (500+ apps)

envs.label: User id
envs.hint: Which Composio user's connected accounts to use (default jonathan)

sources.notes: Gmail, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Google Sheets, GitHub and 500 more through one key. Agents search the catalogue, connect an app (you get a link to approve) and run actions.
